items.title: Cathie Wood Bets $91M on Anthropic IPO While Paring Crypto Exposure
items.summary: The firm bought 934,968 Anthropic shares across six ETFs on the Claude maker’s Nasdaq debut while trimming a combined $4.1 million from its Ethereum and Solana staking ETFs.

items.title: Data centers went from about 3% of Oregon’s electricity use to about 23% in a decade — and account for 96% of its power-sales growth since 2020
items.summary: A Harvard-led study estimated 403 U.S. data centers use roughly 82 terawatt-hours of electricity a year, the equivalent of nearly 8 million homes.
items.titleZh: 数据中心在十年内从俄勒冈州用电量的约3%上升到约23%，自2020年以来占其电力销售增长的96%
items.summaryZh: 哈佛大学领导的一项研究估计，403个美国数据中心每年使用大约82太瓦时的电力，相当于近800万个家庭的用电量。

items.title: AI stocks are selling off after Anthropic’s record IPO, and Wall Street is split on whether this is the top
items.summary: The Dow fell 1,101 points Thursday as Anthropic closed its debut up 17%. Capital Economics says the falls “have further to run.” Goldman still sees 8,700.
items.titleZh: 在Anthropic创纪录的首次公开募股后，人工智能股票正在抛售，华尔街对这是否是最高水平存在分歧
items.summaryZh: 道琼斯指数周四下跌1101点，Anthropic首次亮相收盘上涨17%。凯投宏观表示，跌幅“还将继续”。高盛仍预计有8700点。

items.title: ‘You either take the wheel, or we’re going to run into the wall’: The founder who sold Wrike for $2.25 billion forced his engineers to build around AI
items.summary: Andrew Filev’s engineers now ship 5x as many code changes. Getting there meant rewriting hiring and turning every employee into a manager of agents.
items.titleZh: “要么你开车，要么我们会撞到墙上”：这位以22.5亿美元出售Wrike的创始人迫使他的工程师围绕人工智能进行开发
items.summaryZh: Andrew Filev的工程师现在发布的代码更改是原来的5倍。实现这一目标意味着重写招聘，把每个员工都变成代理人的经理。
